--[[
	Transform Mixin  -  converts an Instance into a Part-Icles emitter.
	:Transform stamps attributes, creates PartIcleProperties Configuration + RenderTemplate,
	hides the source. PreSimulateForward / PreSimulateAttachmentForward live in PreSimulate.luau.
]]

local TypeRegistry = require(script.Parent.TypeRegistry)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local DragModel = require(script.Parent.DragModel)
local AtRest = require(script.Parent.AtRest)

return function(Particle)

-- TransformCompleted fires after Transform/TransformModel/transformDirectAccess; lazy create.
if not Particle.TransformCompleted then
	Particle.TransformCompleted = Instance.new("BindableEvent")
end

-- True when `inst` is `holder` or sits inside it.
local function isWithin(inst, holder)
	return inst == holder or inst:IsDescendantOf(holder)
end

-- Children a holder carries into its RenderTemplate so every emitted copy has them: native
-- emitters, lights, attachments and already transformed emitters. A Beam or Trail qualifies
-- only when both of its attachments sit inside the holder; one tied to another part stays put.
local function isNestedContent(child, holder)
	if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") or child:IsA("Attachment") then return true end
	if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or child:IsA("Light") then return true end
	if child:IsA("Beam") or child:IsA("Trail") then
		local attachment0 = child.Attachment0
		local attachment1 = child.Attachment1
		return (attachment0 == nil or isWithin(attachment0, holder)) and (attachment1 == nil or isWithin(attachment1, holder))
	end
	return false
end

-- The children of `part` that move into its RenderTemplate: its nested content when it carries
-- that, and, for a part that shows nothing once transformed, its own mesh, decals and textures.
local function carriedChildren(part, carriesNested, carriesLooks)
	local nested, looks = {}, {}
	for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
		if carriesNested and isNestedContent(child, part) then
			table.insert(nested, child)
		elseif carriesLooks and (child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("Decal")) then
			table.insert(looks, child)
		end
	end
	return nested, looks
end

-- A copy of `item` without `carried` (children of it that will move into the copy): they are made
-- non-Archivable for the Clone, which leaves those out, and get their own Archivable back at once.
-- They never leave the item here: Studio's undo gives back a child moved from one parent in the
-- place to another, and loses one destroyed or moved through nil into a RenderTemplate not yet in
-- the place (Work 2, 2026-10-15). So a RenderTemplate is parented first and they move in after.
local function cloneWithout(item, carried)
	local archivable = table.create(#carried)
	for index, child in ipairs(carried) do
		archivable[index] = child.Archivable
		child.Archivable = false
	end
	local copy = item:Clone()
	for index, child in ipairs(carried) do
		child.Archivable = archivable[index]
	end
	return copy
end

-- Children a transformed Model owns itself; everything else belongs in its RenderTemplate.
local MODEL_INTERNALS = { EmitParent = true, Link = true, AccelTarget = true }
MODEL_INTERNALS[TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME] = true

-- Main dispatch. Plain directAccess Trail/Beam are promote-eligible: Transform stamps
-- PartIcleProperties + RenderTemplate so the item flips classCheck to TrailEmitter / Beam.
function Particle:Transform(part)
	if part:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(part)
	-- A Reactor takes its own, much shorter road: no RenderTemplate, nothing hidden.
	if not typeDef and (part:IsA("Model") or part:IsA("BasePart")) and part:GetAttribute("IsReactor") and TypeRegistry.Types.Reactor then
		return self:TransformReactor(part, TypeRegistry.Types.Reactor)
	end
	if not typeDef then
		-- Lightning / CameraShake dead zone: the discriminator attr is stamped BEFORE
		-- Transform runs, but both classChecks also require the config child (created
		-- below), so no type matches yet. Resolve explicitly.
		if part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsLightning") and TypeRegistry.Types.Lightning then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Lightning
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsCameraShake") and TypeRegistry.Types.CameraShake then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.CameraShake
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsRocks") and TypeRegistry.Types.Rocks then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Rocks
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsRope") and TypeRegistry.Types.Rope then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Rope
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") and TypeRegistry.Types.Distortion then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Distortion
		elseif (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and part:GetAttribute("IsContainer") and TypeRegistry.Types.Container then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Container
		elseif (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and part:GetAttribute("IsForce") and TypeRegistry.Types.Force then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Force
		elseif part:IsA("BasePart") and part:GetAttribute("IsMatte") and TypeRegistry.Types.Matte then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Matte
		else
			return
		end
	end
	local isLightning = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Lightning
	local isCameraShake = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.CameraShake
	local isRocks = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Rocks
	local isRope = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Rope
	local isDistortion = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Distortion
	-- A Container and a Matte are holders only: they keep their own look and get no link, target or shape children.
	local isContainer = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Container or typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Matte
	-- A Force draws nothing and emits no copy: no captured look, link, target or shape children.
	local isForce = typeDef == TypeRegistry.Types.Force

	-- Promoting a directAccess type: swap to the emitter typeDef before createConfig so the
	-- Configuration child carries TrailEmitter / Beam property defaults (not the directAccess shape).
	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if part:IsA("Trail") and TypeRegistry.Types.TrailEmitter then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.TrailEmitter
		elseif part:IsA("Beam") and TypeRegistry.Types.Beam then
			typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types.Beam
		else
			return
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("Model") then
		-- PrimaryPart not required. Model:GetPivot / PivotTo / ScaleTo work via the
		-- computed WorldPivot when PrimaryPart is unset.
		return self:TransformModel(part, typeDef)
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.createConfig(part, typeDef)
	-- A new item's Drag is Roblox's from the start (DragModel.luau).
	DragModel.mark(config)

	-- A Part (plain or rig) or an Attachment is a holder: its nested content moves into the
	-- RenderTemplate, so each emitted copy carries it and none is left on the source.
	-- CameraShake and Distortion emit no clone (nothing under their RenderTemplate ever fires), so
	-- their children stay on the source. A Container keeps its look; its RenderTemplate gets a copy.
	local emitsNoClone = isCameraShake or isDistortion or isForce
	local nested, looks = carriedChildren(part, not emitsNoClone and (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")), part:IsA("BasePart") and not isContainer)

	local renderTemplate = cloneWithout(part, table.move(looks, 1, #looks, #nested + 1, table.clone(nested)))
	renderTemplate.Name = "RenderTemplate"

	for _, child in renderTemplate:GetChildren() do
		if child:GetAttribute("Transformed") or child:IsA("Attachment") then continue end
		if child.Name == TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME or child.Name == "EmitParent" or child.Name == "Link" or child.Name == "AccelTarget" or child.Name == "Target" or child.Name == "ImageFlipbooks" then
			child:Destroy()
		elseif part:IsA("Light") or part:IsA("Highlight") or part:IsA("Sound") then
			child:Destroy()
		elseif part:IsA("Attachment") then
			-- Strip plugin internals; keep authored Trails/Beams/Decals.
			if child.Name == "MeshFlipbooks" or child.Name == "BeamFlipbooks" or child.Name == "GraphBlender" then
				child:Destroy()
			end
		elseif part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
			-- Keep UIComponent decorators (UIGradient/UICorner/UIStroke/UIPadding).
			if not child:IsA("UIComponent") then child:Destroy() end
		elseif not child:IsA("SpecialMesh") and not child:IsA("Decal") and not child:IsA("Texture") and not child:IsA("SurfaceAppearance") then
			-- SurfaceAppearance must survive; Emit reads it via FindFirstChildOfClass.
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	-- Strip plugin attributes; preserve user-authored ones.
	for _, attrName in ipairs({"Transformed", "Qwinkle", "IsEmitter", "EmitCount", "EmitDuration", "EmitDelay", "EmissionMode", "AnimateLoop", "PreloadTexture", "LinkMode", "LinkSource"}) do
		renderTemplate:SetAttribute(attrName, nil)
	end

	if renderTemplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		renderTemplate.Anchored = true; renderTemplate.CanCollide = false; renderTemplate.CanQuery = false
		renderTemplate.CanTouch = false; renderTemplate.CastShadow = false; renderTemplate.Massless = true; renderTemplate.Locked = true
		renderTemplate.Transparency = 1
		for _, c in ipairs(renderTemplate:GetChildren()) do
			if c:IsA("Decal") or c:IsA("Texture") then c.Transparency = 1 end
		end
	end

	if renderTemplate:IsA("Attachment") then
		renderTemplate.CFrame = CFrame.new()
	end

	-- In the place before the item's own children move in, each straight from the item (cloneWithout).
	renderTemplate.Parent = part
	for _, child in ipairs(nested) do
		child.Parent = renderTemplate
	end

	-- Silence native PEs/Trails on the RT (they ignore parent hidden state). Skip Transformed
	-- ones  -  directAccess Trails own .Enabled, and nested transformed PEs have their own lifecycle.
	for _, desc in ipairs(renderTemplate:GetDescendants()) do
		if (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		then desc.Enabled = false end
	end
	-- Its Beams and Lights are off there as well, and on again in every copy (AtRest).
	AtRest.silence(renderTemplate)

	-- Capture authored visuals so emitter defaults reflect the source's pre-transform state.
	-- Size: SpecialMesh.Scale wins. Color / Transparency come from the part itself; decals keep
	-- their own look through decal layers (DecalLayers = true below).
	-- Read BEFORE the source's mesh and decals move into the RenderTemplate below.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") and not isCameraShake and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not isForce then
		local sizeVec = part.Size
		local meshChild = part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpecialMesh")
		if meshChild then sizeVec = meshChild.Scale end
		local colorVal = part.Color
		local transparencyVal = part.Transparency
		if isLightning or isRope then
			-- Lightning / Rope have no SizeXYZ graphs; segment cross-section comes from Thickness.
			config:SetAttribute("Thickness", NumberSequence.new(math.max(0.05, math.min(part.Size.X, part.Size.Y))))
		elseif not isRocks then
			-- Rocks has no SizeXYZ either; chunk size = RT Size × ChunkScale roll.
			config:SetAttribute("SizeX", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.X))
			config:SetAttribute("SizeY", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.Y))
			config:SetAttribute("SizeZ", NumberSequence.new(sizeVec.Z))
			config:SetAttribute("DecalLayers", true)
		end
		config:SetAttribute("Color", ColorSequence.new(colorVal))
		config:SetAttribute("Transparency", NumberSequence.new(transparencyVal))
	end

	-- Hide source: its mesh, decals and textures move to the RT, where they draw nothing.
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not isContainer then
		for _, child in ipairs(looks) do
			child.Parent = renderTemplate
			if child:IsA("Decal") then child.Transparency = 1 end
		end
		part.Transparency = 1
		-- Rocks chunks are native physics bodies spawning AT the source  -  a still-
		-- collidable invisible source would depenetrate them explosively.
		if isRocks then part.CanCollide = false end
	elseif part:IsA("Light") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("Sound") then
		part:Stop()
		part.Playing = false
	elseif part:IsA("Highlight") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then
		part.Enabled = false
	elseif part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		part.Visible = false
	end

	if part:IsA("Light") then
		config:SetAttribute("PLRange", NumberSequence.new(part.Range))
		config:SetAttribute("PLBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("PLColor", ColorSequence.new(part.Color))
		config:SetAttribute("Shadows", part.Shadows)
		if part:IsA("SpotLight") or part:IsA("SurfaceLight") then
			config:SetAttribute("PLAngle", NumberSequence.new(part.Angle))
			config:SetAttribute("PLFace", part.Face.Name)
		end
	end
	if part:IsA("Sound") then
		config:SetAttribute("SndVolume", NumberSequence.new(part.Volume))
		config:SetAttribute("SndPlaybackSpeed", NumberSequence.new(part.PlaybackSpeed))
		config:SetAttribute("RollOffMin", part.RollOffMinDistance)
		config:SetAttribute("RollOffMax", part.RollOffMaxDistance)
		config:SetAttribute("Looped", part.Looped)
		renderTemplate.Playing = false
	end

	-- Capture authored PostProcessEffect / Atmosphere into config as single-keypoint sequences.
	if part:IsA("BlurEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("BlurSize", NumberSequence.new(part.Size))
	elseif part:IsA("BloomEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("BloomIntensity", NumberSequence.new(part.Intensity))
		config:SetAttribute("BloomSize", NumberSequence.new(part.Size))
		config:SetAttribute("BloomThreshold", NumberSequence.new(part.Threshold))
	elseif part:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
		config:SetAttribute("CCBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("CCContrast", NumberSequence.new(part.Contrast))
		config:SetAttribute("CCSaturation", NumberSequence.new(part.Saturation))
		config:SetAttribute("CCTintColor", ColorSequence.new(part.TintColor))
	elseif part:IsA("Atmosphere") then
		config:SetAttribute("AtmDensity", NumberSequence.new(part.Density))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmOffset", NumberSequence.new(part.Offset))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmGlare", NumberSequence.new(part.Glare))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmHaze", NumberSequence.new(part.Haze))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmColor", ColorSequence.new(part.Color))
		config:SetAttribute("AtmDecay", ColorSequence.new(part.Decay))
	elseif part:IsA("Highlight") then
		config:SetAttribute("HLFillColor", ColorSequence.new(part.FillColor))
		config:SetAttribute("HLFillTransparency", NumberSequence.new(part.FillTransparency))
		config:SetAttribute("HLOutlineColor", ColorSequence.new(part.OutlineColor))
		config:SetAttribute("HLOutlineTransparency", NumberSequence.new(part.OutlineTransparency))
		config:SetAttribute("HLDepthMode", part.DepthMode.Name)
		-- Adornee picker child: emit-time _resolveAdornee falls through to source.Adornee then
		-- source.Parent when this ObjectValue is unset. Picker UI binds to the ObjectValue's
		-- Value field  -  required for the user-facing Adornee picker.
		if not part:FindFirstChild("Adornee") then
			local ad = Instance.new("ObjectValue"); ad.Name = "Adornee"; ad.Value = nil; ad.Parent = part
		end
	end

	-- RT must never render live (both source + RT live in Lighting / GUI tree).
	if renderTemplate:IsA("PostProcessEffect") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false end

	if part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		if renderTemplate:IsA("ImageLabel") then renderTemplate.Visible = false end
		-- Only force BG=1 from the default; preserve user-authored translucent backdrops.
		if part.BackgroundTransparency == 0 then
			part.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		config:SetAttribute("Image", part.Image)
		config:SetAttribute("Position", part.Position)
		config:SetAttribute("ImgSize", part.Size)
		config:SetAttribute("AnchorPoint", part.AnchorPoint)
		config:SetAttribute("ZIndex", part.ZIndex)
		config:SetAttribute("ScaleType", part.ScaleType.Name)
		config:SetAttribute("ResampleMode", part.ResampleMode.Name)
		if not part:FindFirstChild("ImageFlipbooks") then
			local ff = Instance.new("Folder"); ff.Name = "ImageFlipbooks"; ff.Parent = part
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not part:IsA("Terrain") and not isLightning and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not isForce then
		if not part:FindFirstChild("MeshFlipbooks") then
			local mf = Instance.new("Folder"); mf.Name = "MeshFlipbooks"; mf.Parent = part
		end
	end

	-- Trail promote-to-emitter: disable source + RT Trail (RT gets re-Enabled on each emit clone).
	-- The runtime writes the scalar graphs and TrailLife onto every clone each frame
	-- (TrailEmitter SCALAR_GRAPHS), so they are captured from the source Trail here.
	if part:IsA("Trail") then
		part.Enabled = false
		if renderTemplate:IsA("Trail") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false end
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitLightEmission", NumberSequence.new(part.LightEmission))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitLightInfluence", NumberSequence.new(part.LightInfluence))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitTextureLength", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitMinLength", NumberSequence.new(part.MinLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitMaxLength", NumberSequence.new(part.MaxLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TEmitTrailLife", NumberRange.new(part.Lifetime))
		-- Default GraphBlender: state 1 seeds from source Trail's current Width / Transparency / Color
		-- so the emit immediately matches the visual the user authored before promoting.
		if not part:FindFirstChild("GraphBlender") then
			local gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
			local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
			s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0)
			s1:SetAttribute("Width", part.WidthScale or NumberSequence.new(1))
			s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", part.Transparency or NumberSequence.new(0))
			s1:SetAttribute("Color", part.Color or ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1,1,1)))
			s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
			s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = part
		end
		if not part:FindFirstChild("TrailFlipbooks") then
			local tf = Instance.new("Folder"); tf.Name = "TrailFlipbooks"; tf.Parent = part
		end
	end

	if part:IsA("Beam") then
		part.Enabled = false
		part.LightInfluence = 0 -- Unlit default
		if renderTemplate:IsA("Beam") then renderTemplate.Enabled = false; renderTemplate.LightInfluence = 0 end

		if not part:FindFirstChild("BeamFlipbooks") then
			local bf = Instance.new("Folder"); bf.Name = "BeamFlipbooks"; bf.Parent = part
		end

		config:SetAttribute("BeamBrightness", NumberSequence.new(part.Brightness))
		config:SetAttribute("CurveSize0", NumberSequence.new(part.CurveSize0))
		config:SetAttribute("CurveSize1", NumberSequence.new(part.CurveSize1))
		config:SetAttribute("Width0", NumberSequence.new(part.Width0))
		config:SetAttribute("Width1", NumberSequence.new(part.Width1))
		config:SetAttribute("LightEmission", NumberSequence.new(part.LightEmission))
		config:SetAttribute("BeamLightInfluence", NumberSequence.new(0))
		config:SetAttribute("Segments", NumberSequence.new(part.Segments))
		config:SetAttribute("TextureLength", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureLength))
		config:SetAttribute("TextureSpeed", NumberSequence.new(part.TextureSpeed))
		config:SetAttribute("FaceCamera", part.FaceCamera)
		config:SetAttribute("ZOffset", part.ZOffset)
		config:SetAttribute("BeamTextureMode", part.TextureMode.Name)

		-- _AutoTime marks states whose Time was set by Add State (vs user-edited via TimeBox).
		local gb = Instance.new("Folder"); gb.Name = "GraphBlender"
		local s1 = Instance.new("Configuration"); s1.Name = "1"
		s1:SetAttribute("Time", 0); s1:SetAttribute("Transparency", part.Transparency); s1:SetAttribute("Color", part.Color)
		s1:SetAttribute("_AutoTime", true)
		s1.Parent = gb; gb.Parent = part
	end

	if not part:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Value = nil
		ep.Parent = part
	end

	if (part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Attachment")) and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not part:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		lk.Name = "Link"
		lk.Parent = part
	end

	if (part:IsA("BasePart") or isForce) and not isLightning and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not part:FindFirstChild("AccelTarget") then
		local at = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		at.Name = "AccelTarget"
		at.Value = nil
		at.Parent = part
	end

	-- ShapePart override: when UseShape=true, particles spawn within this BasePart's volume
	-- (using its Size + CFrame). Default Value = source itself so the picker UI shows the
	-- source explicitly; runtime `data.ShapePart or part` fallback handles unset values.
	-- Lightning uses it too (bolt-start scatter volume).
	if part:IsA("BasePart") and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion and not isContainer and not isForce and not part:FindFirstChild("ShapePart") then
		local sp = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		sp.Name = "ShapePart"
		sp.Value = part
		sp.Parent = part
	end

	-- Lightning Point-mode endpoint / Rope end anchor: arcs from the source to this instance.
	if (isLightning or isRope) and not part:FindFirstChild("Target") then
		local tv = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		tv.Name = "Target"
		tv.Value = nil
		tv.Parent = part
	end

	part:SetAttribute("Transformed", true)
	part:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	-- Stable per-emitter id. Clones inherit it, so all clones of one authored emitter
	-- share one EvenDistribution rolling-cycle counter (keyed by this in _evenCycleStore).
	part:SetAttribute("_EvenCycleId", game:GetService("HttpService"):GenerateGUID(false))
	-- Every type starts at one emission per Emit. Mirrored by Migrate's backfill and TransformModel.
	part:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1)
	part:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)
	part:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
	part:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true)
	if part:IsA("BasePart") or part:IsA("Beam") or part:IsA("Trail") or part:IsA("ImageLabel") then
		part:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false)
	end
	-- Atmosphere is singleton-per-Lighting; default to Animate to avoid flickering Emit stacks.
	part:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", part:IsA("Atmosphere") and "Animate" or "Emit")
	part:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
	-- Link-driven types only. Highlight (Adornee-driven) + Trail (Attachment0/1-driven) +
	-- Rope (Target-driven) + CameraShake (no visual) + Container (rides its source) skip these.
	if not isContainer and ((part:IsA("BasePart") and not isCameraShake and not isRocks and not isRope and not isDistortion) or part:IsA("Beam") or part:IsA("Attachment") or part:IsA("Model")) then
		part:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow")
		part:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None")
	end
	pcall(function() Particle.TransformCompleted:Fire(part) end)
end

-- PreSimulateForward / PreSimulateAttachmentForward live in PreSimulate.luau (500-line cap split).

-- Model Transform: the Model's own children move into the RenderTemplate (Motor6Ds and
-- AnimationControllers stay intact), so nothing is left beside it.
function Particle:TransformModel(model, typeDef)
	if model:GetAttribute("Transformed") then return end
	DragModel.mark(TypeRegistry.createConfig(model, typeDef))

	-- The pivot is read first: the Model gives up its PrimaryPart below, and the emitter's
	-- origin (model:GetPivot) must not follow the RenderTemplate when Animate moves it.
	local pivot = model:GetPivot()
	local primaryPart = model.PrimaryPart
	local contents = {}
	for _, child in ipairs(model:GetChildren()) do
		if not MODEL_INTERNALS[child.Name] then table.insert(contents, child) end
	end

	-- Cloned empty so the RenderTemplate keeps the Model's own properties and scale.
	local renderTemplate = cloneWithout(model, contents)
	renderTemplate.Name = "RenderTemplate"
	for _, child in renderTemplate:GetChildren() do
		child:Destroy()
	end
	for _, attrName in ipairs({"Transformed", "Qwinkle", "IsEmitter", "EmitCount", "EmitDuration", "EmitDelay", "EmissionMode", "AnimateLoop"}) do
		renderTemplate:SetAttribute(attrName, nil)
	end

	-- The PrimaryPart stays the Model's descendant: left set, the Model's pivot would follow the
	-- RenderTemplate when Animate moves it. Cleared before the children move, so an undo, which
	-- goes back in turn, sets it again once they are back in the Model.
	model.PrimaryPart = nil
	-- In the place before the Model's children move in, each straight from it (cloneWithout).
	renderTemplate.Parent = model
	for _, child in ipairs(contents) do
		child.Parent = renderTemplate
	end
	renderTemplate.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
	renderTemplate.WorldPivot = pivot
	model.WorldPivot = pivot

	-- Anchor every BasePart; silence native PEs/Trails (they ignore parent hidden state). The
	-- parts stay unlocked: they are the only parts of the Model left to click on in the viewport.
	for _, desc in renderTemplate:GetDescendants() do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.Anchored = true; desc.CanCollide = false; desc.CanQuery = false
			desc.CanTouch = false; desc.CastShadow = false; desc.Massless = true
		elseif (desc:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or desc:IsA("Trail"))
			and not desc:GetAttribute("Transformed")
		then
			desc.Enabled = false
		end
	end

	if not model:FindFirstChild("EmitParent") then
		local ep = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		ep.Name = "EmitParent"
		ep.Value = nil
		ep.Parent = model
	end

	if not model:FindFirstChild("Link") then
		local lk = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
		lk.Name = "Link"
		lk.Parent = model
	end

	model:SetAttribute("Transformed", true)
	model:SetAttribute("Qwinkle", true)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitCount", 1)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitDuration", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("EmitDelay", 0)
	model:SetAttribute("IsEmitter", true)
	model:SetAttribute("PreloadTexture", false)
	model:SetAttribute("EmissionMode", "Emit")
	model:SetAttribute("AnimateLoop", false)
	model:SetAttribute("LinkMode", "Follow")
	model:SetAttribute("LinkSource", "None")
	pcall(function() Particle.TransformCompleted:Fire(model) end)
end

end

--[[
	Turbulence  -  Perlin-noise wander shared by Part / Attachment / Model / Lightning.
	Absolute offset at normalized life i:
	  turb(i) = amp(i) * (noise(t, seed, K0), noise(t, seed, K1), noise(t, seed, K2))
	with t = i * LifeTime * TurbulenceFrequency. Deterministic in i, so reverse
	Timescale and the InvertMotion pre-sim replay the same wander path. Consumers
	integrate a telescoping delta against pData._prevTurbOff  -  separate from
	_prevWorldOff because OnHit Bounce mirrors re-baseline only the PosOffset
	accumulator (EventsCollision.luau); noise is statistically symmetric so it
	never mirrors.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)

-- Non-integer axis decorrelation offsets (math.noise returns 0 on the integer lattice).
local K0, K1, K2 = 0.17, 137.7, 291.3

local Turbulence = {}

-- Flat-zero envelopes (the writeDefaults stamp) count as "no turbulence" so idle
-- emitters skip the per-frame noise work entirely.
function Turbulence.isLive(seq)
	if not seq then return nil end
	if GraphMod.IsStatic(seq) and GraphMod.GetStaticValue(seq, 0) == 0 then return nil end
	return seq
end

-- Absolute pre-DisplacementMode offset at normalized life i.
function Turbulence.sampleRaw(ampGraph, ampSeed, turbSeed, freq, lifeTime, i)
	local amp = GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(i, ampGraph, ampSeed)
	if amp == 0 then return Vector3.zero end
	local t = i * lifeTime * freq
	return Vector3.new(
		amp * math.noise(t, turbSeed, K0),
		amp * math.noise(t, turbSeed, K1),
		amp * math.noise(t, turbSeed, K2))
end

-- Resolve the absolute offset at i into the DisplacementMode frame (no mirror args).
local function resolvedAt(pData, i)
	return Constants.resolveDisplacement(
		Turbulence.sampleRaw(pData.Graphs.Turbulence, pData.Seeds.Turbulence,
			pData._turbSeed, pData.TurbulenceFrequency, pData.LifeTime, i),
		pData.DisplacementMode or "Global", pData.SpawnRotation, pData.SpawnEmitterRotation)
end

-- World-space frame delta vs the previous sample (telescoping vs _prevTurbOff).
function Turbulence.frameDelta(pData, steppedI)
	local worldOff = resolvedAt(pData, steppedI)
	local delta = worldOff - pData._prevTurbOff
	pData._prevTurbOff = worldOff
	return delta
end

-- Stamp graph/seed/flags onto a freshly built pData and prime the accumulator at
-- turb(0) WITHOUT shifting the spawn pose: wander is relative to the spawn point,
-- and reversing time back to t=0 returns exactly to it. Must run AFTER
-- SpawnRotation / SpawnEmitterRotation / LifeTime are set on pData.
function Turbulence.buildInto(pData, data)
	local seq = Turbulence.isLive(data.Turbulence)
	pData.HasTurbulence = seq ~= nil
	if not seq then
		-- AnimateLoop replay re-runs this: clear a prior cycle's graph when the
		-- user edits Turbulence back to flat 0 mid-loop.
		pData.Graphs.Turbulence = nil
		return
	end
	pData.Graphs.Turbulence = seq
	-- Reuse seeds the InvertMotion pre-sim already rolled into the shared seeds
	-- table (Transform.luau PreSimulateForward) so live replay matches the cache.
	pData.Seeds.Turbulence = pData.Seeds.Turbulence or GraphMod.GenerateSeed(seq)
	pData.TurbulenceFrequency = data.TurbulenceFrequency or 1
	pData._turbSeed = pData.Seeds._turbSeed or (math.random() * 997 + 0.5)
	pData._prevTurbOff = resolvedAt(pData, 0)
end

-- Re-prime at AnimateLoop cycle restart (same seed → each cycle replays the same wander).
function Turbulence.reprime(pData)
	if not pData.HasTurbulence then return end
	pData._prevTurbOff = resolvedAt(pData, 0)
end

return Turbulence

--[[
	TypeRegistry  -  schema source of truth for every Part-Icle type.
	TypeData.luau + TypeDataScreen.luau hold per-type tables; this file is generic read/write.
	Enums serialize by Name (string) and deserialize via Enum[enumType][name].
]]

local TypeData = require(script.TypeData)

export type TypeDef = {
	classCheck: (Instance) -> boolean,
	pDataType: string,
	uiSection: string,
	properties: {[string]: {[string]: any}},
	resize: {[string]: any}?,
	retime: {[string]: any}?,
	clipboard: {any}?,
	directAccess: boolean?,
}

local TypeRegistry = {}

TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME = "PartIcleProperties"
TypeRegistry.Types = TypeData.Types

-- Returns (typeDef, typeName) or (nil, nil).
function TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item): (TypeDef?, string?)
	for typeName, typeDef in pairs(TypeRegistry.Types) do
		if typeDef.classCheck(item) then
			return typeDef, typeName
		end
	end
	return nil, nil
end

function TypeRegistry.getTypeName(item): string?
	local _, name = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	return name
end

function TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	return item:FindFirstChild(TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME)
end

-- Resolve attrName overrides (BeamBrightness, PLRange, etc.); falls back to propName.
function TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName): string
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if propDef and propDef.attrName then
		return propDef.attrName
	end
	return propName
end

-- Read property value; enum returns EnumItem (not string).
-- A scalar saved before the property became a graph or a range reads as the flat equivalent.
local function promoteScalar(propDef, raw)
	if type(raw) ~= "number" then return raw end
	if propDef.type == "NumberSequence" then return NumberSequence.new(raw) end
	if propDef.type == "NumberRange" then return NumberRange.new(raw) end
	return raw
end

function TypeRegistry.read(item, propName): any
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return nil end

	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if propDef.attribute then
			local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
			local raw = item:GetAttribute(attrName)
			-- Explicit nil-check so stored `false` round-trips correctly.
			if raw ~= nil then return raw end
			return propDef.default
		end
		local ok, val = pcall(function() return item[propName] end)
		if ok and val ~= nil then return val end
		return propDef.default
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
	local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)

	if raw == nil then return propDef.default end
	raw = promoteScalar(propDef, raw)

	if propDef.type == "enum" and type(raw) == "string" then
		-- Enum[type][name] raises on invalid names; pcall-wrap.
		local ok, enumVal = pcall(function() return Enum[propDef.enumType][raw] end)
		if ok and enumVal then return enumVal end
		return propDef.default
	end

	return raw
end

-- Bump RT _PoolGen so Pool flushes stale-look entries on next acquire. Inlined to keep
-- TypeRegistry's no-upward-dependency invariant (would otherwise require Pool).
local function _bumpPoolGen(item)
	local rt = item:FindFirstChild("RenderTemplate")
	if not rt then return end
	local cur = rt:GetAttribute("_PoolGen") or 0
	pcall(function() rt:SetAttribute("_PoolGen", cur + 1) end)
end

-- Bump RenderTemplate's _PoolGen so pooled visuals invalidate. UI paths that
-- mutate RT directly (Material, Beam Texture, Attachment0/1) call this.
function TypeRegistry.bumpPoolGen(item)
	if not item then return end
	_bumpPoolGen(item)
end

-- Clamp NumberSequence so each keypoint Value >= 0 and Envelope <= Value.
local function _clampNonNegativeSeq(value)
	if typeof(value) ~= "NumberSequence" then return value end
	local kps = value.Keypoints
	local needsClamp = false
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		if kp.Value < 0 or kp.Envelope > kp.Value then needsClamp = true; break end
	end
	if not needsClamp then return value end
	local clamped = {}
	for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
		local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
		local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
		table.insert(clamped, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
	end
	return NumberSequence.new(clamped)
end

-- NaN/invalid guard: refuse writes that would persist garbage (NaN keypoints, infinite
-- numbers, malformed NumberSequence). Runtime guards degrade gracefully but stale-invalid
-- attrs survive across sessions and silently misbehave; reject at the write boundary so
-- the prior good value stays intact.
local function _isInvalidNumber(n)
	return type(n) == "number" and (n ~= n or n == math.huge or n == -math.huge)
end
local function _isInvalidValue(value)
	if type(value) == "number" then return _isInvalidNumber(value) end
	if typeof(value) == "NumberRange" then return _isInvalidNumber(value.Min) or _isInvalidNumber(value.Max) end
	if typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
		for _, kp in ipairs(value.Keypoints) do
			if _isInvalidNumber(kp.Time) or _isInvalidNumber(kp.Value) or _isInvalidNumber(kp.Envelope) then
				return true
			end
			if kp.Time < 0 or kp.Time > 1 then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Write property value; enum stored as Name string (config) or EnumItem (direct).
function TypeRegistry.write(item, propName, value)
	if _isInvalidValue(value) then
		warn("[Part-Icles] TypeRegistry.write rejected invalid value for " .. tostring(propName))
		return
	end
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return end

	if typeDef.directAccess then
		if propDef.nonNegative then
			value = _clampNonNegativeSeq(value)
		end
		if propDef.attribute then
			local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
			item:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
		else
			pcall(function() item[propName] = value end)
		end
		_bumpPoolGen(item)
		return
	end

	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return end

	local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)

	if propDef.type == "enum" then
		if typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value.Name)
		else
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, tostring(value))
		end
	else
		-- nonNegative: clamp NumberSequence Value AND Envelope so Value + rand[-E,+E] >= 0.
		if propDef.nonNegative and typeof(value) == "NumberSequence" then
			local kps = value.Keypoints
			local needsClamp = false
			for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
				if kp.Value < 0 or kp.Envelope > kp.Value then needsClamp = true; break end
			end
			if needsClamp then
				local clamped = {}
				for _, kp in ipairs(kps) do
					local v = math.max(0, kp.Value)
					local e = math.max(0, math.min(kp.Envelope, v))
					table.insert(clamped, NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(kp.Time, v, e))
				end
				value = NumberSequence.new(clamped)
			end
		end
		config:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
	end
	_bumpPoolGen(item)
end

-- Read every property into a flat table (generic GetData).
function TypeRegistry.readAll(item): {[string]: any}?
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.getTypeFor(item)
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local config = TypeRegistry.getConfig(item)
	if not config then return nil end

	local data = {}
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		local attrName = TypeRegistry.getAttrName(typeDef, propName)
		local raw = config:GetAttribute(attrName)
		if raw == nil then
			data[propName] = propDef.default
		elseif propDef.type == "enum" and type(raw) == "string" then
			data[propName] = Enum[propDef.enumType][raw]
		else
			data[propName] = promoteScalar(propDef, raw)
		end
	end
	return data
end

-- Stamp every default property; called by Transform. An optional property stays absent:
-- read() answers its default, and Migrate does not count it as missing.
function TypeRegistry.writeDefaults(config, typeDef)
	for propName, propDef in pairs(typeDef.properties) do
		if propDef.optional then
			continue
		end
		local attrName = propDef.attrName or propName
		local value = propDef.default
		if propDef.type == "enum" then
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value.Name)
		else
			config:SetAttribute(attrName, value)
		end
	end
end

-- New Configuration with defaults stamped; parented to item.
function TypeRegistry.createConfig(item, typeDef)
	local config = Instance.new("Configuration")
	config.Name = TypeRegistry.CONFIG_NAME
	TypeRegistry.writeDefaults(config, typeDef)
	config.Parent = item
	return config
end

function TypeRegistry.isGraph(propDef): boolean
	return propDef.type == "NumberSequence" or propDef.type == "ColorSequence"
end

function TypeRegistry.isNonNegative(propDef): boolean
	return propDef.nonNegative == true
end

function TypeRegistry.getPropDef(typeName, propName)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	return typeDef.properties[propName]
end

-- Type-aware default lookup; required because pairs() over Types isn't order-stable.
function TypeRegistry.getDefault(typeName, propName)
	local typeDef = TypeRegistry.Types[typeName]
	if not typeDef then return nil end
	local propDef = typeDef.properties[propName]
	if not propDef then return nil end
	return propDef.default
end

-- True when `desc` sits under a RenderTemplate between itself and `root` (exclusive).
-- Lifecycle.haltEmission skips such natives: they are template state, not live emission.
function TypeRegistry.isInsideRenderTemplate(desc, root)
	local node = desc.Parent
	while node and node ~= root do
		if node.Name == "RenderTemplate" then return true end
		node = node.Parent
	end
	return false
end

return TypeRegistry

--[[
	TypeData  -  property descriptors for 3D / workspace types (Part / Beam / PointLight /
	Attachment / Model / Trail). Screen types live in TypeDataScreen.luau (500-line split).

	Property entry: { type, default, attrName?, enumType?, nonNegative?, attribute?, optional? }
	  attrName    config attribute name override (avoids collision with native props)
	  enumType    Roblox Enum category name (required for type="enum")
	  nonNegative NumberSequence keypoints clamped to >= 0 on write
	  attribute   directAccess only  -  store as instance attribute, not property
	  optional    absent until it is set, and absence reads as the default: Transform does not
	              stamp it (TypeRegistry.writeDefaults) and Migrate does not count it as missing
]]

local TypeData = {}

TypeData.PartProperties = {

	PosOffsetY    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },
	PosOffsetZ    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },

	-- progresses monotonically through its keypoints regardless of which direction
	-- the particle's effective time is moving. Initial `_effectiveElapsed` depends on
	-- the graph's value at i=0: ts(0) >= 0 → particle starts at 0 and plays forward;
	-- ts(0) < 0 → particle starts at LifeTime (end-state visual) and rewinds to 0.
	-- This is what makes a STATIC `Timescale = -1` produce end-to-start playback.

	of TypeData.luau (TypeDataRocks pattern).

local Container = {}

--[[
	TypeDataDistortion  -  Distortion type definition (screen-space glass
	distortion canvas; runtime in Modules/Part/Distortion/). Merged into
	TypeData.Types at the bottom of TypeData.luau (TypeDataLightning pattern).

	A Distortion item is a transformed BasePart discriminated by the
	IsDistortion attribute. Every active effect sums its height field into ONE
	shared camera-locked glass plane (Distortion/Canvas.luau)  -  overlapping
	glass planes cull each other, so per-effect planes cannot exist.
]]

local Distortion = {}

Distortion.DistortionProperties = {
	-- Field selection + shape. All screen-space quantities live in plane UV
	-- units (the canvas is 8x5 plane-studs); they are world-scale-invariant.
	FieldKind    = { type = "string", default = "Ripple" },
	-- Vertex displacement envelope over life (slope-normalized at write time
	-- so perceived strength is FOV- and wavelength-invariant).
	Amplitude    = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.5), nonNegative = true },
	Wavelength   = { type = "number", default = 1.5, nonNegative = true },
	-- SIGNED: negative = inward ripple / reversed wave / reversed scroll.
	Speed        = { type = "number", default = 3 },
	-- Degrees; Wave travel + Noise scroll direction.
	Direction    = { type = "number", default = 0 },
	NoiseScale   = { type = "number", default = 2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Bulge/Pinch dome radius (UV studs).
	LensRadius   = { type = "number", default = 1.5, nonNegative = true },

	-- Epicenter: WorldPoint = the item's live position (or moving nested clone,
	-- or Events AtPosition override) projected to the screen each frame;
	-- ScreenCenter = fixed center.
	EpicenterMode = { type = "string", default = "WorldPoint" },
	-- Camera-to-epicenter linear attenuation in world studs; 0 = global
	-- (ShakeFalloff semantics).
	Falloff      = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },

	-- Plane glass Transparency over life: 1 = invisible, ~0.5-0.75 = peak
	-- refraction, below ~0.5 = dark semi-mirror, above 1 = overdrive request
	-- (engine-quirk zone, effective ~4-10). MIN-composed across active effects
	-- (strongest glass wins). Default fades out so the plane never pops.
	Transparency = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0.3, 1), nonNegative = true },
	-- Software gain on this item's height contribution (always safe).
	Strength     = { type = "number", default = 1, nonNegative = true },
	-- Transparency>1 overdrive request (effective 4..10; 0 = off). Plane-global,
	-- composed by MAX across active effects; vetoed unless EVERY active effect
	-- opted in via AllowOverdrive (conservative wins).
	Amplify        = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	AllowOverdrive = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	-- Mesh grid width (verts across; height keeps the 24:14 aspect). The plane
	-- is shared: the HIGHEST active request wins, and it never downgrades until
	-- teardown. Cost scales quadratically  -  OptCalc reflects it.
	Resolution     = { type = "number", default = 24, nonNegative = true },

	-- Standard timing family. Timescale supports signed reverse (negative
	-- segments run the field animation backward).
	Timescale      = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1) },
	Lifetime       = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(0.5) },
	Rate           = { type = "number", default = 10 },
	Enabled        = { type = "boolean", default = false },
	TotalKeyFrames = { type = "number", default = 100 },
}

Distortion.Types = {
	Distortion = {
		-- IsDistortion stamped by Actions.TransformSelectionAsDistortion BEFORE
		-- Transform; config-child requirement keeps this disjoint from Part's
		-- classCheck under getTypeFor's unordered iteration.
		classCheck = function(item)
			return item:IsA("BasePart") and item:GetAttribute("IsDistortion") == true
				and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") ~= nil
		end,
		pDataType = "Distortion",
		uiSection = "Distortions",
		properties = Distortion.DistortionProperties,

		-- Screen-space props (Amplitude/Wavelength/LensRadius) are world-scale-
		-- invariant; only the world-distance Falloff scales.
		resize = {
			scaleNumbers = { "Falloff" },
		},
		retime = {
			multiplyNumbers = { "Rate", "Speed" },
			divideRanges = { "Lifetime" },
		},
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Emission", props = {"Rate", "Lifetime", "Timescale", "EmitCount", "EmitDelay", "EmitDuration"}},
			{name = "Field", props = {"FieldKind", "Amplitude", "Wavelength", "Speed", "Direction", "NoiseScale", "LensRadius"}},
			{name = "Screen", props = {"EpicenterMode", "Falloff", "Strength", "Transparency", "Amplify", "AllowOverdrive", "Resolution"}},
			{name = "Advanced", props = {"TotalKeyFrames"}},
			{name = "Events", props = {"OnEmit", "OnDeath", "OnDestruction"}},
		},
	},
}

return Distortion

--[[
	TypeDataForce  -  Force type definition: a transformed Part or Attachment that draws nothing
	and pushes Reactor pieces while it lives (runtime in Modules/Part/Force/). Merged into
	TypeData.Types at the bottom of TypeData.luau (TypeDataCameraShake pattern).

	An Impulse lasts as long as its front needs to cross the shape (Travel Time, or one instant
	at 0); Lifetime is the length of a Continuous force, and of an Impulse that travels (one
	with a Link or any Motion).

	Spawn, Motion and Link are a mesh's: the same properties under the same names, placed and
	moved by the mesh's own code (Modules/Part/Force/Path). Link is item-level, as on a mesh.
]]

local Force = {}

-- Stored as the panel's dropdowns show them; Force/Fields and Force/init compare these strings.
Force.SHAPES = { "Sphere", "Cone", "Linear", "Vortex" }
Force.KINDS = { "Impulse", "Continuous" }
Force.CUTS = { "Off", "Halves", "Pieces", "Band" }

-- The Spawn and Motion properties a Force shares with a mesh. TypeData.luau copies each
-- definition from PartProperties at the merge, so there is one definition of each.
Force.FROM_PART = {
	"PosMode", "PosX", "PosY", "PosZ", "PosXEven", "PosYEven", "PosZEven", "PositionEvenCycle",
	"RotOrder", "RotX", "RotY", "RotZ", "RotXEven", "RotYEven", "RotZEven", "RotationEvenCycle",
	"PosXLinkedTo", "PosYLinkedTo", "PosZLinkedTo", "RotXLinkedTo", "RotYLinkedTo", "RotZLinkedTo",
	"SpreadAngle", "DirMode", "VelocityVectored", "Speed", "Acceleration", "Drag", "InvertMotion",
	"DisplacementMode", "PosOffsetX", "PosOffsetY", "PosOffsetZ", "TurbulenceFrequency",
	"PosOffsetXLinkedTo", "PosOffsetYLinkedTo", "PosOffsetZLinkedTo",
	"RotMode", "RotSpeedX", "RotSpeedY", "RotSpeedZ",
	"RotSpeedXLinkedTo", "RotSpeedYLinkedTo", "RotSpeedZLinkedTo",
	"AccelerationTowardsInstance", "AccelStrength",
}

Force.ForceProperties = {
	Shape = { type = "string", default = "Sphere" },
	-- Impulse: one kick as the front passes. Continuous: a flow that carries pieces while it lasts.
	ActsAs = { type = "string", default = "Impulse" },
	-- Over the force's life. Impulse: how far, in studs, a piece at the origin is thrown
	-- (Force/Fields.throwSpeed). Continuous: the speed, in studs per second, pieces are carried
	-- at (Reactor/Driven). Negative pulls.
	Strength = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(12) },
	-- How much of the Strength is lost by the edge of the shape, 0 to 1: 1 fades to nothing
	-- there, 0 pushes as hard at the edge as at the origin. The runtime keeps it in that range.
	Falloff = { type = "number", default = 1, nonNegative = true },

	-- Reach in studs: a Sphere's or Cone's radius, a Linear's length, a Vortex's radius.
	Range = { type = "number", default = 30, nonNegative = true },
	-- Nothing closer than this is pushed.
	Inner = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- Linear: the box's cross-section. Vortex: Height is its length along the axis.
	Width = { type = "number", default = 20, nonNegative = true },
	Height = { type = "number", default = 20, nonNegative = true },
	-- Cone: the full opening angle in degrees.
	Angle = { type = "number", default = 60, nonNegative = true },
	-- The face of the item the shape points along.
	EmissionDirection = { type = "enum", enumType = "NormalId", default = Enum.NormalId.Front },
	-- Motion's Direction: the face of the item the Force travels along. A mesh keeps this in
	-- EmissionDirection, which a Force already uses for its shape.
	MoveDirection = { type = "enum", enumType = "NormalId", default = Enum.NormalId.Front },
	-- Motion's Turbulence: wander of the Force's own path, in studs over its life. A mesh keeps
	-- this in Turbulence, which a Force already uses for gusts.
	MotionTurbulence = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0) },

	-- Seconds the push takes to travel from the origin to the edge of the shape, so far pieces
	-- react after near ones; 0 reaches everything at once.
	TravelTime = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- Impulse: an upward share added to the kick. Vortex: the share along its axis. A Continuous
	-- Sphere, Cone or Linear goes where its shape points and ignores it.
	Lift = { type = "number", default = 0.7 },
	-- Vortex: the shares of Strength around the axis and toward it.
	Spin = { type = "number", default = 1 },
	Pull = { type = "number", default = 0.5 },

	-- Random spread of the strength each piece feels, 0 to 1.
	Variation = { type = "number", default = 0.2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Continuous: gusts, as a share of Strength each piece's speed swings by over time.
	Turbulence = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- 0: every piece is thrown alike. 1: a piece twice the reference size is thrown half as far.
	-- A small piece is never thrown farther than Strength.
	SizeResponse = { type = "number", default = 0.5, nonNegative = true },
	-- Reactors with this Group react; empty reaches every Reactor.
	Group = { type = "string", default = "" },
	-- What a ground does once this Force's crack has come to rest (Reactor/Wounds), in place
	-- of the Reactor's own After and Delay: "Reactor's" leaves both to the Reactor, and the
	-- Delay here counts only with one of the others (Stay, Fade, Return, as the panel lists them).
	After = { type = "string", default = "Reactor's" },
	AfterDelay = { type = "number", default = 2, nonNegative = true },
	-- The pieces of the crack this Force makes in a ground, in place of the Reactor's Pieces.
	-- Under 2, the default, leaves it to the Reactor.
	Pieces = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- A Linear Impulse may cut what it strikes with its own shape as the blade (Reactor/Carve):
	-- "Off", or what becomes of the part: Halves (its two sides stay whole), Pieces (they break
	-- into the part's own pieces), Band (the sides stay whole and what the blade took out
	-- flies off as debris). The thinner of Width and Height is the cut's width.
	Cut = { type = "string", default = "Off" },
	-- How far, in studs, a cut throws its sides: along the way the Force heads, and apart, each
	-- to its own side of the cut. With both near 0 the side that lies on the cut slides off
	-- under its own weight.
	PushAlong = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	PushApart = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- A jagged cut: how far, in studs, the cut strays to either side of its line (0 is a clean
	-- cut), and how long one jag is, along the cut and across it (Reactor/Blade).
	CutNoise = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	CutNoiseScale = { type = "number", default = 4, nonNegative = true },

	Lifetime = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	-- A graph over the Lifetime, read in real time as a mesh's Timescale is. It runs the Force's
	-- own clock (front, strength, path) and the Reactors whose pieces the Force moves: 0.25 is
	-- quarter speed, 0 holds the debris in the air. A Force with one lasts its Lifetime. When
	-- the Lifetime is over time runs normally again, so a graph that eases out ends at 1.
	-- Nothing rewinds: a value below 0 is 0. Flat at 1, the default, is no Timescale at all.

--[[
	TypeDataMatte  -  Matte type definition: a transformed Part that draws nothing itself and
	shows the mesh part-icles nested in it as windows onto one picture (runtime in
	Modules/Part/Matte/). Merged into TypeData.Types at the bottom of TypeData.luau
	(TypeDataRocks pattern).
]]

local Matte = {}

-- Stored as the panel's Back Faces dropdown shows them; Matte/Sides.CHOICES repeats these strings.
Matte.BACK_FACES = { "Auto", "Off", "X", "Y", "Z" }
-- Stored as the panel's View Mode dropdown shows them; Matte/View.MODES repeats these strings.
Matte.VIEW_MODES = { "Tilted", "Semi Tilt", "Middle", "Front", "On Top" }
-- Stored as the panel's Flipbook Mode dropdown shows them; Modules/Part/Flipbook reads Loop and
-- PingPong and plays anything else once over the Lifetime. None plays no flipbook.
Matte.FLIPBOOK_MODES = { "None", "OneShot", "Loop", "PingPong" }

Matte.MatteProperties = {
	-- The play's length in seconds, rolled once per play; the graphs below run over it.
	Lifetime = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(2), nonNegative = true },
	-- Plays per second while Enabled.
	Rate     = { type = "number",  default = 1 },
	Enabled  = { type = "boolean", default = false },

	-- The picture the shapes show. Stored on the item's MatteField child as well (Matte/Field):
	-- a game script cannot put a texture on it.
	Texture      = { type = "string", default = "" },
	-- How tall the picture is laid, in view heights: 1 is as tall as the screen, 0.25 repeats it four times up the screen.
	TextureScale = { type = "number", default = 1, nonNegative = true },
	-- The axis a DoubleSided mesh is mirrored along to show its other side (Matte/Sides).
	BackFaces    = { type = "string", default = "Auto" },

	-- sheet, or on one sheet for them all: tilted into a face of the box around them, or
	-- facing the camera at their middle, in front of them, or at the camera.
	ViewMode     = { type = "string", default = "Tilted" },
	-- Keeps a play's layers and textures for the item's next play (Matte/LayerPool, Matte/Looks).
	-- Off, every play builds its own and destroys them when it ends.
	Pool         = { type = "boolean", default = true, optional = true },

	-- The frames are the numbered Decals of the item's MatteFlipbooks folder (Matte/Field).
	FlipbookMode        = { type = "string",      default = "OneShot" },

	MaskFlipbookStartRandom = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
	MaskFlipbookReverse     = { type = "boolean",     default = false },
	-- Which of the two an Inventory insert fills: every active one, the picture when neither is

	PictureActive = { type = "boolean", default = true },
	MaskActive    = { type = "boolean", default = false },

	Brightness   = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(1), nonNegative = true },
	-- Fades the whole layer: 0 is solid, 1 is gone.
	Transparency = { type = "NumberSequence", default = NumberSequence.new(0), nonNegative = true },
	-- Tints the picture; white leaves it as it is.
	Color        = { type = "ColorSequence", default = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1)) },

--[[
	TypeDataReactor  -  Reactor type definition: a transformed Model or Part whose parts are
	pieces that Forces push (runtime in Modules/Part/Reactor/). Merged into TypeData.Types at
	the bottom of TypeData.luau (TypeDataCameraShake pattern).
	A Reactor has no RenderTemplate and emits nothing: its parts stay as they were built, and a
	play moves unsaved stand-ins of them.

	giveTo(typeDef) hands a part-icle type the settings its emitted copy reacts by
	(Modules/Part/Reactor/HandOver); TypeData.luau calls it for the Part type at the merge.
]]

local Reactor = {}

-- Stored as the panel's dropdowns show them; Reactor/Play and Reactor/Pieces compare these strings.
Reactor.AFTER = { "Stay", "Fade", "Return" }
Reactor.BREAK = { "None", "Blocks", "Shards" }
Reactor.SHARD_PATTERNS = { "Even", "Around hit", "Cracks" }
Reactor.SCATTER_TURN = { "Upright", "Any way" }
Reactor.SCATTER_SHAPES = { "Box", "Circle", "Region shape" }

-- What a part-icle that becomes a Reactor keeps on its own config, under the Reactor's names:
-- GetDataRig.readReacting reads them with the Reactor's reader. Collapse is left out, since
-- every piece of an emitted copy is let go, and so is Scatter, which fills a standing Reactor.
Reactor.PARTICLE_KEYS = {
	"Hold", "HoldSpread", "Group", "MaxPieces", "Break", "Pieces", "ShardPattern",
	"Gravity", "Bounciness", "Friction", "TumbleSpeed", "MaxAirTime", "After", "AfterDelay", "AfterTime",
}
-- A copy is never a ground, so the pattern that is cracked ground is not offered for one.
Reactor.PARTICLE_PATTERNS = { "Even", "Around hit" }

Reactor.ReactorProperties = {
	-- Shown as "Resistance" and "Resistance Randomness" (BuildPropertiesReactor, ToolPanels.DISPLAY_NAMES).
	-- The throw, in studs, a piece shrugs off: a Force that would move it no farther leaves it standing.
	Hold = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },
	-- How much Hold differs from piece to piece, 0 to 1: at 0.3 a piece holds 0.7 to 1.3 of it,
	-- so a wall gives way unevenly.
	HoldSpread = { type = "number", default = 0.3, nonNegative = true },
	-- None: every part moves whole. Blocks: every part is cut into about Pieces blocks, as near
	-- to cubes as the count allows (Reactor/Dice): a plain block-shaped Part by arithmetic, any
	-- other shape by the engine. Shards: every part is cut by the engine into about Pieces real
	-- fragments (Reactor/Shards). The engine cuts what draws its own shape (a Part, a wedge, a
	-- mesh, a union); a Part carrying a mesh and a truss still move whole.
	Break = { type = "string", default = "None" },
	-- Blocks or shards a part breaks into, each part on its own; at most Reactor/Sites.MAX, and
	-- fewer for a very small part.
	Pieces = { type = "number", default = 50, nonNegative = true },
	-- Even: shards of about one size, cut ahead so the first Force is answered at once.
	-- Around hit: small where the first Force is and large away from it; the cut can only be
	-- made when that Force arrives, so the Reactor answers it a few frames late.
	-- Cracks: cracked ground around the first Force, as far as its Range: a crust of pieces in
	-- rings over a base that never moves. The crater's pieces are thrown, or sunk and tipped
	-- when they hold; around it the ground is heaved, and hairline cracks run on from there.
	ShardPattern = { type = "string", default = "Even" },
	-- A piece left standing with nothing under or beside it that still reaches the ground is let
	-- go and falls (Reactor/Support). One that floats from the start is never made to fall.
	Collapse = { type = "boolean", default = true },
	-- Forces whose Group is empty or equal to this reach the Reactor.
	Group = { type = "string", default = "" },

	-- Rolled once per piece when it is first pushed; the Rocks names and meanings.
	Gravity = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(196.2) },
	Bounciness = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(0.3, 0.5), nonNegative = true },
	Friction = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(0.5, 0.7), nonNegative = true },
	TumbleSpeed = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(90, 360) },
	-- Seconds a piece may stay in the air. Its path looks for ground that long, so a piece
	-- thrown high or dropped from a height comes down and lands; one still in the air after it
	-- (nothing under it, or thrown off the map) is taken away. Never less than a second.
	MaxAirTime = { type = "number", default = 15, nonNegative = true },

	-- Once every piece has come to rest: Stay where they lie, Fade (sink away) or Return (the
	-- flight played backwards).
	After = { type = "string", default = "Stay" },
	-- Seconds between the last piece resting and the Fade or Return.
	AfterDelay = { type = "number", default = 2, nonNegative = true },
	-- Seconds the Fade or the Return takes.
	AfterTime = { type = "number", default = 1.5, nonNegative = true },

	-- The Scatter section's recipe (plugin: Modules/Scatter). The runtime does not read these;
	-- what Fill places are ordinary parts in the Reactor's "Scattered" folder.
	ScatterCount = { type = "number", default = 40, nonNegative = true },
	-- The clear ground between two placed pieces, in studs; 0 lets them touch.
	ScatterSpacing = { type = "number", default = 1, nonNegative = true },
	-- Upright: each piece is turned about the vertical only. Any way: turned freely.
	ScatterTurn = { type = "string", default = "Upright" },
	-- Each piece's size, as a share of the source's own.
	ScatterSize = { type = "NumberRange", default = NumberRange.new(0.8, 1.2), nonNegative = true },
	-- The same Seed places the same field.
	ScatterSeed = { type = "number", default = 1 },
	-- The outline the pieces are kept to: the Region's box, the circle that fits it, or the
	-- Region part's own shape. Hollow is the share of a Circle's radius left empty in the middle.
	ScatterShape = { type = "string", default = "Box" },
	ScatterHollow = { type = "number", default = 0, nonNegative = true },

	-- The most pieces of this Reactor that may be out of place at once.
	MaxPieces = { type = "number", default = 800, nonNegative = true },
}

Reactor.Types = {
	Reactor = {
		-- IsReactor is stamped by Actions.TransformSelectionAsReactor BEFORE Transform; the
		-- config-child requirement keeps this disjoint from the Part and Model classChecks,
		-- which exclude IsReactor, during the transform window.
		classCheck = function(item)
			return (item:IsA("Model") or item:IsA("BasePart")) and item:GetAttribute("IsReactor") == true
				and item:FindFirstChild("PartIcleProperties") ~= nil
		end,
		pDataType = "Reactor",
		uiSection = "Reactors",
		properties = Reactor.ReactorProperties,

		resize = {
			scaleNumbers = { "Hold", "ScatterSpacing" },
			scaleRanges = { "Gravity" },
		},
		retime = {
			multiplyRanges = { "TumbleSpeed" },
			squareRanges = { "Gravity" },
			divideNumbers = { "AfterDelay", "AfterTime", "MaxAirTime" },
		},
		clipboard = {
			{name = "Response", props = {"Hold", "HoldSpread", "Group", "MaxPieces"}},
			{name = "Break", props = {"Break", "Pieces", "ShardPattern", "Collapse"}},
			{name = "Motion", props = {"Gravity", "Bounciness", "Friction", "TumbleSpeed", "MaxAirTime"}},
			{name = "After", props = {"After", "AfterDelay", "AfterTime"}},
			{name = "Scatter", props = {"ScatterShape", "ScatterHollow", "ScatterCount", "ScatterSpacing", "ScatterTurn", "ScatterSize", "ScatterSeed"}},
		},
	},
}

-- Gives a part-icle type the switch, Reacts, and PARTICLE_KEYS with the Reactor's own
-- definitions. Each is optional (TypeData.luau): absent until it is set, its absence its
-- default, so an item without them has nothing to Fix. Resize and Retime treat them as a
-- Reactor's; the clipboard group is borrowed (PropertyCatalog.merge), so each stays in the
-- category the Reactor, a Force or Rocks gave it.
function Reactor.giveTo(typeDef)
	local taken = {}
	local group = { name = "Reactor", props = { "Reacts" }, borrowed = true }
	typeDef.properties.Reacts = { type = "boolean", default = false, optional = true }
	for _, key in ipairs(Reactor.PARTICLE_KEYS) do
		local definition = table.clone(Reactor.ReactorProperties[key])
		definition.optional = true
		typeDef.properties[key] = definition
		taken[key] = true
		table.insert(group.props, key)
	end

	local own = Reactor.Types.Reactor
	for _, tool in ipairs({ "resize", "retime" }) do
		typeDef[tool] = typeDef[tool] or {}
		for listName, keys in pairs(own[tool]) do
			for _, key in ipairs(keys) do
				if taken[key] then
					typeDef[tool][listName] = typeDef[tool][listName] or {}
					table.insert(typeDef[tool][listName], key)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	typeDef.clipboard = typeDef.clipboard or {}
	table.insert(typeDef.clipboard, group)
end

return Reactor

--[[
	Update Mixin  -  per-frame update for Part / Beam (Attachment lives in UpdateAttachment.luau).
	Returns true when Lifetime expires (swap-and-pop or animate-loop reset).
	Hot-path zero-allocation contract: no CFrame/Vector3/table creation in step loops.
]]

local GraphMod = require(script.Parent.Graph)
local DecalLayersMod = require(script.Parent.DecalLayers)
local Constants = require(script.Parent.PartConstants)
local NestedScale = require(script.Parent.NestedScale)
local LinkCF = require(script.Parent.LinkCF)
local UpdateCommon = require(script.Parent.UpdateCommon)
local EventsCollision = require(script.Parent.EventsCollision)
local Turbulence = require(script.Parent.Turbulence)
local ContainerColors = require(script.Parent.Container.Colors)
local DirectionVectors = Constants.DirectionVectors
local _posOffsetFrameDelta = UpdateCommon._posOffsetFrameDelta
local _composeLocalDelta = UpdateCommon._composeLocalDelta
local _turnsDisplacement = UpdateCommon._turnsDisplacement
local _turnedFrameDelta = UpdateCommon._turnedFrameDelta

-- World position for target-accel; nil for destroyed / no-Position types.
-- Bone before BasePart (Bone IS-A BasePart but .Position is bind pose, not live).
local function getTargetPosition(target)
	if not target or not target.Parent then return nil end
	if target:IsA("Bone") then return target.TransformedWorldCFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("BasePart") then return target.Position end
	if target:IsA("Attachment") then return target.WorldPosition end
	if target:IsA("Camera") then return target.CFrame.Position end
	if target:IsA("Model") then local ok, cf = pcall(target.GetPivot, target); if ok and cf then return cf.Position end end
	return nil
end

-- A Container's hold on this particle's look (its carried record, pData._drive): the
-- record's brightness multiplies, its colour acts by the Container's Color Mode.
local function drivenLook(pData, color, brightness)
	local drive = pData._drive
	if not drive then
		return color, brightness
	end
	if drive.look then
		color = ContainerColors.driven(pData, color, drive)
	end
	return color, brightness * drive.brightness
end

return function(Particle)

-- Part update: position (4 branches), rotation, size, color/transparency, flipbook.
-- Branches: Inverted reads precomputed CFrames; VelocityVectored and a "Rotating" displacement
-- need full per-step iteration; fast paths skip ahead with no accel/drag.
function Particle:UpdatePart(pData, dt, currentTime)
	-- Signed-reverse Timescale: ts sampled at real_i (not effective i) so it progresses
	-- monotonically through keypoints regardless of effective-time direction. ts(0)<0 →
	-- particle starts at end of life and rewinds; ts(0)>=0 → starts forward.
	-- SetTimescale override (Lifecycle.luau) wins over the graph for its window.
	local real_i = math.min(math.max((currentTime - pData.StartTime) / pData.LifeTime, 0), 1)
	local ts
	if pData._tsOverride ~= nil and currentTime < (pData._tsOverrideUntil or 0) then
		ts = pData._tsOverride
	else
		ts = pData.Graphs.Timescale and GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(real_i, pData.Graphs.Timescale, pData.Seeds.Timescale) or 1
	end
	-- Carried by a Container: its Timescale graph runs this particle's time too.
	local drive = pData._drive
	if drive then ts = ts * drive.timescale end
	dt = dt * ts
	local lifeTime = pData.LifeTime
	local priorEff = pData._effectiveElapsed or 0
	local newEff = priorEff + (pData._timeFrozen and 0 or dt)
	if dt < 0 and pData._hitHistory and #pData._hitHistory > 0 then
		EventsCollision.restoreHitsOnReverse(pData, priorEff, newEff)
	end
	if newEff < 0 then newEff = 0 end
	if newEff > lifeTime then newEff = lifeTime end
	pData._effectiveElapsed = newEff
	-- After-clamp dt: boundary frames see partial step instead of overshooting.
	-- Reactor/Momentum steps a play by hand and reads this, AccumulatedDT and CurrentStep.
	dt = newEff - priorEff
	pData._lastEffectiveDt = dt
	-- Particle dies when effective sits at a boundary AND the graph has finished playing.
	local atForwardEnd = newEff >= lifeTime
	local atBackwardEnd = newEff <= 0
	local elapsedTime = newEff
	local i = elapsedTime / lifeTime

	if not pData.VisualPart or not pData.VisualPart.Parent then return true end
	if pData.TotalKeyFrames <= 0 then return true end
	local graphFinished = real_i >= 1
	-- OnHit Collision=Stop (or auto-settle freeze): skip motion/step work, age normally.
	if pData._collisionStopped then return graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd) end

	-- Nested-Model scale: fold the parent Model's current scale into nested-particle motion.
	-- motionFactor scales the spatial delta (Speed/Accel/PosOffset) when ScaleMotion; rotFactor
	-- scales RotSpeed (via rotDamp) when ScaleRotation; sizeFactor scales Size. 1 when not nested.
	local sizeFactor, motionFactor, rotFactor = 1, 1, 1
	if pData.ParentScale then
		sizeFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod)
		motionFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "motion")
		rotFactor = Constants.getParentScaleFactor(pData.ParentScale, currentTime, GraphMod, "rotation")
	end
	-- What the copy holds keeps to the Model's scale and to the Container's (NestedScale).
	if pData._scaledContent then NestedScale.apply(pData._scaledContent, sizeFactor, drive and drive.scale) end
	-- A Container's Scale graph sizes the mesh; its motion is its own.
	if drive then sizeFactor = sizeFactor * drive.scale end
	local isDying = graphFinished and (atForwardEnd or atBackwardEnd)
	i = math.min(math.max(i, 0), 1)

	pData.AccumulatedDT += dt
	local targetStep = math.floor(i * pData.TotalKeyFrames)

	if targetStep ~= pData.CurrentStep then
		local prevStep = pData.CurrentStep
		local stepDir = (targetStep > prevStep) and 1 or -1
		local stepsToProcess = math.abs(targetStep - prevStep)
		local perStepDT = pData.AccumulatedDT / stepsToProcess
		local frameDT = pData.AccumulatedDT
		pData.AccumulatedDT = 0

		-- Collision spin (deg/sec) into _spinAccum (degrees); composes with both rotation modes.
		local spinRate = pData._spinRate
		if spinRate and (spinRate.X ~= 0 or spinRate.Y ~= 0 or spinRate.Z ~= 0) then
			pData._spinAccumX = (pData._spinAccumX or 0) + spinRate.X * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumY = (pData._spinAccumY or 0) + spinRate.Y * frameDT
			pData._spinAccumZ = (pData._spinAccumZ or 0) + spinRate.Z * frameDT
		end
		local speedMult = pData.SpeedMultiplier or 1
		local turns = _turnsDisplacement(pData)

		-- POSITION: Inverted
		if pData.InvertMotion then
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			local reverseStep = pData.TotalKeyFrames - targetStep
			local localCF = pData.SimLocalCFrames[reverseStep] or pData.SimLocalCFrames[0]
			local parentCF_now = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = parentCF_now * localCF
			pData._localWorldCF = localCF
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position

		-- POSITION: Forward, FULL iteration (VelocityVectored, or a displacement that turns)
		elseif pData.NeedsFullIteration or turns then
			-- parentCF_now / dirInfo hoisted outside the loop; final CFrame written once at batch end.
			local vectored = pData.NeedsFullIteration
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local dirInfo = DirectionVectors[pData.EmissionDirection] or DirectionVectors[Enum.NormalId.Top]
			local localCF = pData.LocalCF
			local accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ = pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ
			local baseDir = pData.BaseDirection
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero
			local targetVel = pData.TargetVel
			-- Seed simPos from live VisualPart.Position (overlays moved CFrame since CurrentPosition write).
			local simPos = pData.VisualPart.Position
			local rotMode = pData.RotMode
			local rotOrder = pData.RotOrder or "Global"
			local lastWorldCF, lastLocalWorldCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime

				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				local draggedSpeed = hasDrag and (speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec)) or speed

				local displacement
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					displacement = (baseDir * draggedSpeed + accelVel) * perStepDT
				else
					displacement = baseDir * (draggedSpeed * perStepDT)
				end

				-- Target accel: Euler integration; reads simPos for mid-substep tracking.
				if pData.HasTargetAccel then
					local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
					if tPos then
						local toTarget = tPos - simPos
						local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
						if dist > 1e-4 then
							local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
							if mag and mag ~= 0 then
								targetVel = targetVel + toTarget * (mag * perStepDT / dist)
								displacement = displacement + targetVel * perStepDT
							end
						end
					end
				end

				-- This step's rotation graphs, read before the position: a turning displacement needs them.
				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp

				local rotX, rotY, rotZ
				if rotMode == "Speed" then
					accRotX = accRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
					accRotY = accRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
					accRotZ = accRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
					rotX, rotY, rotZ = accRotX + sx, accRotY + sy, accRotZ + sz
				else
					rotX, rotY, rotZ = rotSpeedX + sx, rotSpeedY + sy, rotSpeedZ + sz
				end

				-- PosOffset per-step delta. Telescoping sums integrate to the absolute-offset
				-- change. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the velocity; a Local-mode offset is
				-- already link-local and added as-is (else a spinning Weld precesses it).
				local posDelta, posIsLL
				if turns then
					posDelta, posIsLL = _turnedFrameDelta(pData, si, useVOS, stepDir, rotDamp, rotSpeedX, rotSpeedY, rotSpeedZ)
				else
					posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, si, useVOS)
				end
				local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, displacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
				localCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * localCF

				local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(rotOrder, rotX, rotY, rotZ)
				lastWorldCF = (parentCF_now * localCF) * rotationCFrame
				lastLocalWorldCF = localCF * rotationCFrame
				simPos = lastWorldCF.Position

				-- Only a VelocityVectored play heads where it faces; any other keeps its direction.
				if vectored then
					local rotatedCF = lastWorldCF * pData.SpreadRotation
					baseDir = rotatedCF[dirInfo.vector] * dirInfo.multiplier
				end
			end
			pData.LocalCF = localCF
			pData.AccRotX, pData.AccRotY, pData.AccRotZ = accRotX, accRotY, accRotZ
			pData.BaseDirection = baseDir
			pData._accelVel = accelVel
			pData.TargetVel = targetVel
			pData.CurrentPosition = simPos
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep
			if lastWorldCF then
				pData.VisualPart.CFrame = lastWorldCF
				pData._localWorldCF = lastLocalWorldCF
			end

		-- POSITION: Forward, SPEED ROTATION
		elseif pData.NeedsRotAccum then
			local hasDrag = pData.HasDrag
			local hasAccel = pData.HasAccel
			local totalScalarDisp = 0
			local totalAccelDisp = Vector3.zero
			local accelVel = pData._accelVel or Vector3.zero

			for step = prevStep + stepDir, targetStep, stepDir do
				local si = step / pData.TotalKeyFrames
				local elapsedSec = si * pData.LifeTime
				local speed = pData._speedOverride or ((pData._staticSpeed or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.Speed, pData.Seeds.Speed)) * speedMult)
				if hasDrag then speed = speed * math.exp(-pData.Drag * elapsedSec) end
				totalScalarDisp = totalScalarDisp + speed * perStepDT
				if hasAccel then
					local effA = Constants.applyContactAccel(pData.Acceleration, pData, perStepDT)
					accelVel = accelVel + effA * perStepDT
					totalAccelDisp = totalAccelDisp + accelVel * perStepDT
				end

				local rotDamp = (pData._settleRotDamp or 1) * rotFactor
				local rotSpeedX = (pData._staticRotSpeedX or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedX, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedX)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedY = (pData._staticRotSpeedY or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedY, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedY)) * rotDamp
				local rotSpeedZ = (pData._staticRotSpeedZ or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(si, pData.Graphs.RotSpeedZ, pData.Seeds.RotSpeedZ)) * rotDamp
				pData.AccRotX = pData.AccRotX + rotSpeedX * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotY = pData.AccRotY + rotSpeedY * perStepDT
				pData.AccRotZ = pData.AccRotZ + rotSpeedZ * perStepDT
			end
			pData._accelVel = accelVel

			local totalDisplacement = pData.BaseDirection * totalScalarDisp + totalAccelDisp

			-- Target accel: frame-granularity (mid-frame si).
			if pData.HasTargetAccel then
				local tPos = getTargetPosition(pData.AccelTarget)
				if tPos then
					local toTarget = tPos - pData.VisualPart.Position
					local dist = toTarget.Magnitude
					if dist > 1e-4 then
						local frameDT2 = perStepDT * (targetStep - prevStep)
						local midSI = ((prevStep + 1 + targetStep) * 0.5) / pData.TotalKeyFrames
						local mag = pData._staticAccelStrength or GraphMod.QueryPointsWithTime(midSI, pData.Graphs.AccelStrength, pData.Seeds.AccelStrength)
						if mag and mag ~= 0 then
							pData.TargetVel = pData.TargetVel + toTarget * (mag * frameDT2 / dist)
							totalDisplacement = totalDisplacement + pData.TargetVel * frameDT2
						end
					end
				end
			end

			-- PosOffsetX/Y/Z over-life position graphs. _composeLocalDelta VOS's only the
			-- world velocity; a Local-mode offset is already link-local and added as-is so a
			-- spinning Weld lets the radius shrink instead of precessing the offset.
			local parentCF_now, useVOS = LinkCF.parentFrame(pData)
			local posDelta, posIsLL = _posOffsetFrameDelta(pData, targetStep / pData.TotalKeyFrames, useVOS)
			local parentLocalDelta = _composeLocalDelta(parentCF_now, useVOS, totalDisplacement, posDelta, posIsLL, motionFactor)
			pData.LocalCF = CFrame.new(parentLocalDelta) * pData.LocalCF
			local sx = pData._spinAccumX or 0
			local sy = pData._spinAccumY or 0
			local sz = pData._spinAccumZ or 0
			local rotationCFrame = Constants.composeRotation(pData.RotOrder or "Global", pData.AccRotX + sx, pData.AccRotY + sy, pData.AccRotZ + sz)

			pData.VisualPart.CFrame = (parentCF_now * pData.LocalCF) * rotationCFrame
			pData._localWorldCF = pData.LocalCF * rotationCFrame
			pData.CurrentPosition = pData.VisualPart.Position
			pData.CurrentStep = targetStep

		-- POSITION: Forward, FAST
